stories.title: Campaign launched for later Wrexham to Bidston trains after evening games
stories.summary: Football fans using the Borderlands line to reach evening games at Wrexham’s Racecourse often have to choose between the final whistle and the last train home, two Senedd Members have said. stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has been in a heightened state of escalation for 11 years, and has spent more than nine of them in special measures. stories.title: Flintshire and Wrexham the most productive places in Wales, ONS figures show
stories.summary: Flintshire and Wrexham are the most productive places in Wales, according to new figures from the Office for National Statistics (ONS). stories.title: 64 Flintshire patients still in hospital days after they were ready to go home
stories.summary: On one day in October, 64 Flintshire people were still in hospital at least two days after they were ready to go home.
